children: CIBUS ACQUIRES PROPERTIES FROM COOP VÄST IN SWEDEN FOR EUR 36.0 MILLION AND EXTENDS EXISTING LEASES WITH COOP
CIBUS NORDIC REAL ESTATE AB (PUBL) - TOTAL INVESTMENT AMOUNTS TO EUR 36.0 MILLION, WITH ANNUAL RENTAL INCOME OF EUR 2.4 MILLION
TO ACQUIRE 13 PROPERTIES IN SWEDEN AND HAS SIMULTANEOUSLY EXTENDED 17 LEASES WITH COOP IN ITS EXISTING PORTFOLIO.
HAS ALSO EXTENDED 17 EXISTING LEASES WITH COOP VÄST IN SWEDEN BY 12 YEARS, UNTIL DECEMBER 2038.
